facade now places 481 blocks with 0 REFUSED and 0 OFF-PALETTE; the fix is an unclaimed() write filter in parts/facade.mjs that drops facade writes into cells earlier parts already hold (above ground). ./make.sh wrote build.nbt.
The 54 refused writes were the roof prism and eave overlapping the portico and window hoods; no facade block changed, so those spots still read blank.
Other parts (front site, back yard, East passage, bedrooms, bath, closet) still show REFUSED lines; they are outside this fix.
left: The facade lost detail at 54 cells because roofs.mjs owns them: the solid roof prism fills the north wall at z=11 (BR2/BR3 windows, palladian glazing) and the roof eave at y=9 sits on the hood plane (z=6, z=25/26), and the portico cornice at z=10 is roof stairs/blackstone. Real fix belongs in roofs.mjs (prism-on-box, eave overlap), not facade.
Other parts still refused writes into earlier parts (not in scope): front site 5, back deck and yard 6, East passage 4, Bedroom 2 1, Bedroom 3 1, Primary bedroom 1, Primary bath 2, Walk-in closet 2.
Facade's writes are dropped silently by design, so the build is byte-for-byte the same as before this change; it only removes the refusal noise.
